messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ಆ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಯ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಶಾಂತವಾಯಿತು, ಅದು ನನ್ನ ಹೃದಯದ ಸರೋವರದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು ನಾನು ಬಹಳ ದಯೆಯಿಂದ ಕಳೆದ ರಾತ್ರಿಯು.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Allor | “then, at that moment” | **ಆ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ** | “at that time” | OK | | fu | copular past “was” | — | — | **MISSING** | | la *(article before “paura”)* | definite article, fem. sing. | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | paura | “fear” | **ಭಯ** | “fear” | OK | | un | indefinite article (part of degree phrase) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | poco | “a little, slightly” | **ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ** | “a little” | OK | | queta | “quieted, calmed” | **ಶಾಂತವಾಯಿತು** | “became quiet” | OK | | che | relative pronoun “which/that” | **ಅದು** | “that (fear)” | OK | | nel | “in the” (prep + def. art.) | **ನಲ್ಲಿ** (as part of **ಸರೋವರದಲ್ಲಿ**) | “in” | OK | | lago | “lake” | **ಸರೋವರ** | “lake” | OK | | del | genitive “of the” | **ದ** (genitive suffix) | “of” | OK | | cor | “heart” (poetic) | **ಹೃದಯ** | “heart” | OK | | m'era | pluperfect auxiliary + dative “to me had” | **ನನ್ನ** | “my” | OK | | durata | “had lasted” | **ಉಳಿದಿತ್ತು** | “had remained/lasted” | OK | | la *(article before “notte”)* | definite article, fem. sing. | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | notte | “night” | **ರಾತ್ರಿ** | “night” | OK | | ch'i' | relative pronoun “that I” | **ನಾನು** | “I” | OK | | passai | “I passed” (simple past) | **ಕಳೆದ** | “passed” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | **ದಯೆಯಿಂದ** | “with pity” | OK | | tanta | “so much, great” | **ಬಹಳ** | “very” | OK | | pieta | “pity” | **ದಯೆ** (root of **ದಯೆಯಿಂದ**) | “pity” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING**: **fu** – the copular verb “was” is not overtly expressed in the Kannada rendering (the meaning is absorbed into the verb *ಶಾಂತವಾಯಿತು*). - **UNNECESSARY**: Articles **la** (twice) and **un** are naturally omitted in Kannada; their absence is appropriate.
No WRONG translations or GRAMMAR agreement problems were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
